**Major update: FarmDash Trail Marshal moves from static cookbook to guarded orchestration and workflow session management.**

- Adds new tools: `plan_workflow`, `run_workflow`, and `get_workflow_status` for session-based guarded orchestration.
- Workflow quality gates classify available, missing, and state-changing steps based on installed skills before execution.
- Workflow run records can now be created and tracked per session; workflows requiring execution now move to `awaiting_confirmation` until user approval via the appropriate sub-skill.
- Expanded catalog to 14 orchestrated workflow recipes with updated step metadata.
- Trail Marshal still performs no on-chain execution and only interacts with user-approved, separately-installed execution skills.

FarmDash Trail Marshal v0.2.0 – Catalog and API update

- Updated the workflow catalog: revised recipe set, improved descriptions, and step details.
- Unified workflow filtering: legacy `category`/`tier` filters are now a general `filter` string.
- Updated step syntax: each workflow lists steps as `{ skill, tool, purpose }` entries; obsolete aliases (e.g., `get_balances`) are removed.
- Introduced workflow Quality Gate pattern: classify missing/execution steps, safe subsets, and enforce fallback for incomplete tooling.
- Tier pricing and access updated: Pioneer tier is now $29/mo and filter support follows API changes.
- Improved agent guidance on catalog caching and skill availability handling.

FarmDash Trail Marshal v0.1.1

- Converts to a strictly read-only metadata cookbook (“static catalog” model).
- Removes all environment variables and credential surfaces; no keys or tokens required.
- Now exports one tool only: list_workflows — returns a canonical set of named workflow recipes, each detailing its required user confirmations and sub-skill handoffs.
- All workflow execution, signature, and state change is explicitly delegated to the user’s separately-installed sub-skills under their own contracts.
- Updates documentation for agent guidance, security stance, and risk warnings.
- Reorganizes and clarifies tier model, recipe summaries, and permission boundaries.

FarmDash Trail Marshal v0.1.0 — initial release

- Introduces Trail Marshal as a read-only workflow composition/catalog layer for FarmDash agents.
- Publishes a canonical workflow catalog via the `list_workflows` tool, enabling deterministic multi-skill orchestration.
- Supports cross-skill workflows spanning Trail Intelligence, Wagon Steward, Signal Architect, and Futures Strategist.
- No transaction/signing; does not analyze or execute, only guides agents on workflow sequencing and confirmation.
- Ideal when user goals require coordination of more than one FarmDash skill or an end-to-end farming plan.
